### **M**essage **O**n **J**oin
Is a simple Client-Side Mod sending a Message to your chat when joining a Server/World.

You can Change the Join Messages in 
```
Game instance/config/MOJ/config.yml
```
reload the instance and the Message changed!

You can also use **Mini Messages Markdown** to Change color and more! and when you use **{player}** it will Show the Players Name :-)
